name: jp.keijiro.gltfast-tweaks
description: Editor extension that adds per-asset texture import overrides (downscale, GPU compression, filter mode) to the glTFast importer.
author: Keijiro Takahashi

_upm.changelog:
Fixed
- Fixed compile errors with glTFast 7.0's assembly and API renames.

Changed
- Referenced the glTFast assembly by GUID to survive the rename.
- Raised the glTFast dependency to 6.20.0.
